reason: report_dashboard_09 proves the size limit refuses before the body is read and tries a foreign Host on every route
summary: report_dashboard_09's 'too large' case sends Content-Length 65537 with a ~150-byte body: with the MAX_BODY check removed the server times out reading (READ_TIMEOUT 10s) and answers the same 400 DASHBOARD_BAD_REQUEST, so the 64 KiB guard is unproven; no case shows the refusal comes before the body is read (no headers-only request), and foreign Host is tried on 2 of the /api routes. By hand a 70123-byte body is refused at once with 'the body is 70123 bytes; the limit is 65536'. Standards pass.
